title: Pink-haired Archer Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with pink hair in pigtails, wearing green and black armor with a cape, shown running and firing a glowing arrow from a bow. Green liquid splashes and magical effects appear around her in the later frames. The image is divided into vertical panels against a solid green background.
prompt: A four-panel sprite sheet sequence showing a cute anime-style female archer with bright pink hair in high pigtails and a small crown, wearing green and black fantasy armor with a flowing cape. She is depicted in successive running and shooting poses, firing a magical arrow with green energy and splash effects. The character has a determined expression, shown against a vibrant lime green background in a clean 2D digital illustration style.
